entry.title: Biweekly report · 2026-11-16
entry.summary: On Nov 5 the S&P 500 fell 4.4% on doubts about how artificial intelligence spending is being financed, and it recovered 2.5% the following week. October inflation pushed the 10-year yield from 4.89% to 5.12%, and on Nov 16, a day before NVIDIA's earnings, the index fell another 1.9%. Bitcoin ended the two weeks down 19%.

entry.title: Starting point · 2026-11-04
entry.summary: This report sets the starting point: the portfolio and the S&P 500 start at 100 on November 4, 2026. There is no return to compare yet. The first period is measured at the snapshot of November 18, 2026.
